question: For each department in the library system, list the name of the department, total number of courses using library materials, the number of catalog items associated with those courses, and the average enrollment per course. Include a grand total across all departments (the corresponding department field should be 'Grand Total').
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_matrl_detail" AS SELECT "library_course_instructor_key" AS "library_course_instructor_key", "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key", "library_subject_offered_key" AS "library_subject_offered_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "subject_id" AS "subject_id" FROM beaver.library_reserve_matrl_detail;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_subject_offered" AS SELECT "library_subject_offered_key" AS "library_subject_offered_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "subject_id" AS "subject_id", "subject_title" AS "subject_title", "offer_dept_code" AS "offer_dept_code", "offer_dept_name" AS "offer_dept_name", "num_enrolled_students" AS "num_enrolled_students" FROM beaver.library_subject_offered;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_catalog" AS SELECT "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key" FROM beaver.library_reserve_catalog;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_course_instructor" AS SELECT "library_course_instructor_key" AS "library_course_instructor_key", "department" AS "department" FROM beaver.library_course_instructor;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH reserve_links AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        lrm.term_code,
        lrm.subject_id,
        lrm.library_reserve_catalog_key
    FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrm
    WHERE lrm.subject_id IS NOT NULL AND lrm.term_code IS NOT NULL
),
subject_info AS (
    SELECT
        lso.term_code,
        lso.subject_id,
        lso.offer_dept_name AS dept_name,
        lso.num_enrolled_students AS enrollment
    FROM library_subject_offered lso
),
linked AS (
    SELECT
        rl.term_code,
        rl.subject_id,
        si.dept_name,
        si.enrollment,
        rl.library_reserve_catalog_key
    FROM reserve_links rl
    LEFT JOIN subject_info si
      ON rl.term_code = si.term_code AND rl.subject_id = si.subject_id
),
-- per department per course stats
per_course AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'Unknown') AS department,
        term_code,
        subject_id,
        MAX(COALESCE(enrollment, 0)) AS enrollment,
        COUNT(DISTINCT library_reserve_catalog_key) AS catalog_items_for_course
    FROM linked
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
per_dept AS (
    SELECT
        department,
        COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id || ':' || term_code) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
        SUM(catalog_items_for_course) AS total_catalog_items,
        AVG(NULLIF(enrollment,0)) AS average_enrollment_per_course
    FROM per_course
    GROUP BY 1
),
grand AS (
    SELECT
        'Grand Total' AS department,
        SUM(total_courses_using_library_materials) AS total_courses_using_library_materials,
        SUM(total_catalog_items) AS total_catalog_items,
        AVG(average_enrollment_per_course) AS average_enrollment_per_course
    FROM per_dept
)
SELECT * FROM per_dept
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM grand
ORDER BY CASE WHEN department = 'Grand Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, department;
